Beautiful Camrose

Camrose is home to an extensive network of parks, trails, and playgrounds that make it easy to enjoy the outdoors year-round. Whether you’re looking for a peaceful walk by the lake, an afternoon of family fun at the playground, or an active adventure along our trails, there’s something for everyone. Explore how our green spaces bring nature, recreation, and community together.
